about.text:
QA engineer with experience in manual and automated testing of web and mobile applications. Java automation across UI, API, and mobile using JUnit 5, Selenide, Appium, and REST Assured. Experience with Allure reporting, CI pipelines, and Git.

Outside of work: games, music, technology, and an enduring curiosity about how things work.

todoist-test-automation.title: Multi-Layer Test Automation Framework for Todoist app
todoist-test-automation.description: Enterprise-grade multi-layer test automation framework covering the same product across API, Web UI, and Android platforms. Designed as a multi-module Gradle project with unified reporting, CI integration, and environment-agnostic execution model.
